purpose: Hand-authored display copy proposal. Expected behavior illustrations from the public task contract, not executed results. Exact original title, description and requirements remain available.

tasks.originalTitle: Retain first occurrences throughout a list
tasks.title: Remove repeated list items
tasks.summary: The function misses duplicates that are separated by other items. Keep the first copy of each item, in order.

tasks.originalTitle: Preserve a final partial list block
tasks.title: Keep the last short batch
tasks.summary: Splitting a list into batches currently drops the last batch when it is short. Keep every item.

tasks.originalTitle: Honor signed cyclic list shifts
tasks.title: Rotate lists in both directions
tasks.summary: Negative shifts currently rotate the wrong way. Positive shifts should move right; negative shifts should move left.

tasks.originalTitle: Keep unpaired values during list weaving
tasks.title: Keep leftover items when combining lists
tasks.summary: Alternating between two lists currently loses items from the longer list. Append those leftover items in order.

tasks.originalTitle: Count adjacent list runs independently
tasks.title: Count consecutive repeats separately
tasks.summary: The function combines matching items even when they are separated. Count each consecutive group on its own.

tasks.originalTitle: Repeated page marks fragment contiguous reading runs
tasks.title: Ignore duplicate page marks
tasks.summary: Repeated page marks split reading ranges incorrectly. Sort the distinct pages and group consecutive numbers.

tasks.originalTitle: Exact-capacity sessions split too early
tasks.title: Fill reading sessions to the limit
tasks.summary: Chapters that exactly fill a reading session are split too early. Keep them together when their total equals the limit.

tasks.originalTitle: Chapter boundary pages resolve to the wrong chapter
tasks.title: Keep a chapter’s last page in that chapter
tasks.summary: Looking up the last page of a chapter gives the wrong chapter. Both page and chapter numbers start at one.

tasks.originalTitle: Later reading sessions replace earlier page totals
tasks.title: Add every reading session to the total
tasks.summary: A later reading session replaces a book’s earlier total. Add all its sessions and keep books in first-seen order.

tasks.originalTitle: Half-percent progress ties round down unexpectedly
tasks.title: Round half-percent progress upward
tasks.summary: Progress at an exact half percent uses the wrong rounding rule. Round halfway values upward.

tasks.originalTitle: Retain fill-down history across blank worksheet spans
tasks.title: Fill blank cells from earlier rows
tasks.summary: Blank rows and missing cells erase the remembered value of a column. Keep that value for later blank cells.

tasks.originalTitle: Keep explicit empty cells during worksheet transposition
tasks.title: Preserve empty cells when swapping rows and columns
tasks.summary: The transpose function replaces existing null cells with padding. Use padding only where a cell is missing.

tasks.originalTitle: Include the final complete worksheet window
tasks.title: Include a window ending at the last row
tasks.summary: The function drops a complete window that ends exactly at the worksheet boundary. Include it; omit only incomplete windows.

tasks.originalTitle: Count zero-valued worksheet cells as populated
tasks.title: Count zero as a populated cell
tasks.summary: Column counts ignore zero-valued cells. Count every integer, including zero and negative values.

tasks.originalTitle: Limit worksheet row deduplication to consecutive runs
tasks.title: Remove only neighboring duplicate rows
tasks.summary: The function removes later rows that match an earlier row. Collapse consecutive duplicates; keep separated repeats.

tasks.originalTitle: Restore adjacency-aware band coalescing
tasks.title: Merge only neighboring bands of the same color
tasks.summary: Combining colored bands currently moves separated colors together. Merge adjacent matches and preserve the pattern’s order.
tasks.expectedBehavior: red(2), red(3), blue(1), red(2) → red(5), blue(1), red(2)

tasks.originalTitle: Restore partial-band span extraction
tasks.title: Keep partial bands at a cut edge
tasks.summary: Cutting out a ribbon span loses bands that overlap either edge. Keep the overlapping part of each band.

tasks.originalTitle: Restore whole-pattern tile order
tasks.title: Repeat the whole ribbon pattern
tasks.summary: The repeat function duplicates each band separately. Repeat the full sequence instead.
tasks.expectedBehavior: red(2), blue(1), repeated twice → red(2), blue(1), red(2), blue(1)

tasks.originalTitle: Restore first-use order in material totals
tasks.title: List material totals in first-used order
tasks.summary: Color totals are sorted alphabetically. Keep the order in which each color first appears in the pattern.

tasks.originalTitle: Restore material-distance ribbon rotation
tasks.title: Rotate ribbon by distance, not band count
tasks.summary: The rotation function counts bands instead of material units. Move the start by the given distance, splitting a band if needed.
